All requirements verified and passing. `artifact.html` is self-contained, loads cleanly (HTTP 200), and renders immediately:

- **Analyser:** `fftSize 512` → 256 bins (≥60), smoothing 0.82
- **4 visual modes:** Bars / Rings / Particles / Wave — switchable via buttons (plus keys 1-4)
- **Sources:** file input (`accept="audio/*"` + drag & drop), microphone via `getUserMedia`, and Demo Tone oscillators
- **Playback:** play/pause, stop, seekable progress bar, volume, time display, sensitivity control
- **Animation:** `requestAnimationFrame` loop at 60fps with procedural idle fallback so canvas animates immediately before any audio is loaded
- **Self-contained:** inline CSS/JS only, no external `http` assets, JS syntax valid (33 KB)

File verified at both `/home/ubuntu/artifact.html` and `./artifact.html`.
